key_points.point: Bravehearts Unit 5 BRAVEHEARTS A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers Let us do these activities before we read.
I Homage means ‘something that is said or done to show respect publicly for someone’.
Share your answers with your classmates and the teacher.
II Work in pairs to complete the table by writing any three ways in which we can celebrate the victories and honour the sacrifices of the soldiers.
Celebrating their Victories Honouring their Sacrifices visiting a war memorial
Poorvi 180 Let us read Two friends share their feelings about brave soldiers.
One of them shares her experience of visiting the National War Memorial that has left a deep impact on her.
They exchange letters and share their feelings of gratitude for the freedom they enjoy because of the sacrifices made by the bravehearts of the country.
